replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Since you ban evaded 5 months ago and have not since, I will lift your punishment. However, for your future reference, hopefully it doesn't happen, but we do not allow alternate accounts for users to play on while they're banned, this is breaking the rules and considered ban evasion.

Thank you for your patience.
